facts.statement: The genus Rhinosteus was described by Jaekel in 1911.
Three species are known: the type species R. traquairi described by Jaekel in 1911, and R. parvulus and R. tuberculatus described by Gross in 1932.
facts.quote: subdivision: Rhinosteus traquairi Jaekel, 1911 (type) Rhinosteus parvulus (Gross, 1932) Rhinosteus tuberculatus Gross, 1932

facts.statement: Rhinosteus was a small to medium-sized placoderm that lived during the Late Devonian period.
facts.quote: Rhinosteus is an extinct genus of small to medium selenosteid arthrodire placoderms of the Late Devonian known from the Upper Frasnian Kellwasserkalk facies of Bad Wildungen, Germany and Morocco.

facts.statement: Fossils of Rhinosteus have been found in the Upper Frasnian Kellwasserkalk facies in Germany and Morocco.
facts.quote: known from the Upper Frasnian Kellwasserkalk facies of Bad Wildungen, Germany and Morocco.

facts.statement: Rhinosteus is characterized by short cheeks and slender lower jaw plates.
facts.quote: Rhinosteus is a typical genus of Kellwasserkalk selenosteids, with short cheeks, and slender inferognathal (lower jaw) plates.

facts.statement: The species R. traquairi and R. tuberculatus possess long, pointed rostrums and tubercles on their plates.
facts.quote: However, two of the species, R. traquairi and R. tuberculatus, have long, pointed rostrums, and tubercles on the plates.

facts.statement: In R. traquairi, the rostrum is sharply pointed and extends beyond the snout, while the tubercles are small and irregularly placed.
facts.quote: In R. traquairi, the rostrum is sharply pointed, extending beyond the snout, and the tubercles are small and irregularly placed.

facts.statement: The average skull length of R. tuberculatus is 15 centimetres, whereas R. parvulus measures 4 to 6 centimetres.
facts.quote: The average skull length of R. tuberculatus is 15 centimetres, while that of R. parvulus is 4 to 6 centimetres.

facts.statement: Rhinosteus belongs to the family Selenosteidae within the clade Aspinothoracidi, which is part of the major clade Pachyosteomorphi.
facts.quote: Rhinosteus is a member of the family Selenosteidae of the clade Aspinothoracidi, which belongs to the clade Pachyosteomorphi, one of the two major clades within Eubrachythoraci.

facts.statement: Rhinosteus is classified as a member of the class Placodermi.
Rhinosteus lived during the Frasnian stage, between 382.31 and 372.15 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Frasnian to Frasnian (382.31 to 372.15 million years ago)
